'''Sigrix Slix''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] musician living during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] who resided on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. He hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] to carry out tasks that were supposedly legal, but the spacer was forced to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] spices to other criminals.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sigrix Slix was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
